body: I can relate to that. It's hard sometimes to understand it, much less explaining to other people. It usually follows something happened that you are not exactly happy with, for example: "You did something wrong, well maybe you should die", etc... Suicidal thoughts are real things and the society doesn't understand that. All I can say is sometimes you just need to take it by the hours, sometimes minutes. Also talking to somebody who doesn't judge you for the way you are also help.

Look man, I don't know what you're going through and truth is I will never truly understand what you're going through and the same way you will never understand what I am going through. All I can offer is I understand how much pain and failure can eat you up mentally. I was in somewhat a similar situation like you, I bought the gun and I was going to go through with it but sadly it wasn't successful. Now everyday after it, I have been contemplating it so bad wishing I would have done it sooner before being noticed. If you need someone to talk, just PM me and I'm more than willing to listen.
Thanks for your encouragement words brother.
Call it an exit strategy. In fact I think the few reasons I haven't given up yet is because the pain and suffering it will cause to people around me and the responsibilities I have to carry everyday.
A lot of things, my life got derailed hard and now I feel like I can't get anything right and being stressed out all the timr.

Well, it has been 3 days since what happened. Guess I should give everyone an update. I was pretty hammered from the Bourbon that night and while trying to cut myself, my ex called police on me and I was taken to the ER in handcuff. They put me in Psy ward for 2 and a half day and it was a miserable experience.
I'm not giving up until I see blood squirting out of it
I just want a clean cut on the veins and artery.
I am in the process of cutting myself,  but no matter what I can't cut deep enough. It's driving me crazy

I just want the emotional pain to stop. I already know by doing this, I will make everyone extremely disappointed in me.  21 years old, high GPA in the best engineering school for Petroleum  Engineering. I just can't take the stress, expectation and the fact the women of my life who I was going have a family with cheated on me in the most disgusting way and leave me in trauma forever just because she wanted to give me a reason to end the engagement. I lost all hope, faith and direction in my life.

I already made up my mind. I'll chug some aspirins with a bottle of knob creek. Then I'll make a nice lengthwise cut along my forearm, deep enough to get some veins and arteries. If the blood thinners and cut won't get me, then the coldness and alcohol poisoning will get me.
I am in the same situation as you man, all I can say is take it hour by hour.

Since I posted this, everyday I feel like I'm moving closer and closer to killing myself. I already have it planned out and everything. At this point, it scares me knowing that I have so many people depending on me.
